boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, named study environments in Courtright Memorial Library, selected for their documented seating, technology, whiteboards, or sensory features.

cards.title: Library 011 Seminar Room
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · lower level
cards.notes: Reserve this lower-level room for a group session; use its movable tables, two walls of glass whiteboards, projector, and HDMI-ready TV.
cards.short_summary: A flexible seminar room with whiteboard-heavy walls and presentation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 011 has movable tables, seating for 16, large glass whiteboards, a projector, document camera, and an HDMI-connected TV area for smaller meetings.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed by the library as a reservable room; located on the lower level.

cards.title: Library 013 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · lower level
cards.notes: Bring a project that needs screens: use the open-air lab’s student computers, scanner, central tables, and five TVs for sharing work.
cards.short_summary: An open computer lab built around individual stations and a central worktable.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 013 is an open-air computer lab with 19 student computers, middle-table seating, a scanner, five TVs, and presentation equipment.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: The library states priority for this space goes to the Library, Academic Support Center, and Center for Teaching and Learning.

cards.title: Library 127 Project Room
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use this first-floor room when your group needs to sketch and rearrange: whiteboards surround movable tables and chairs for up to 24.
cards.short_summary: A reconfigurable project room with surrounding whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 127 has whiteboards around movable tables and chairs seating 24, plus a projector, document camera, and DVD player; it can serve large or small group projects.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed as a reservable room on the first floor, in the back hallway past the Otterbean Cafe.

cards.title: Library 200 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Set up for computer-based work in this 25-station lab; its instructor computer, projector, document camera, and DVD player support shared review.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor computer lab with 25 student workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 200 is a second-floor computer lab with 25 student computers, an instructor computer, data projector, document camera, and DVD player.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed by the library as a reservable computer lab near the second-floor stairs.

cards.title: Library 201 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose this lab for a computer task with a small team: it pairs 19 student computers with an 8–10 seat center table, scanner, and printer.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab that combines individual stations with a shared central table.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 201 has 19 student computers, central seating for 8–10, an instructor computer, projector, document camera, scanner, printer, and DVD player.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed as a reservable computer lab on the second floor near the stairs.

cards.title: Library 202 Neiswender
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use the four-seat round table for a focused team meeting; three glass walls, a small glass whiteboard, and an HDMI TV support quick collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat glass-walled room for compact group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 202 has three glass walls around a round table with four chairs, a small glass whiteboard, and a TV with HDMI connection for personal computers.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed as a reservable conference and study room on the second floor by the elevator.

cards.title: Library 214A Sensory-Friendly Room
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this four-seat room when adjustable lighting helps: it includes a beanbag, small glass whiteboard, HDMI TV, and sensory/self-care items.
cards.short_summary: A sensory-friendly small-group room with dimmable lighting.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 214A contains a round table with four chairs, beanbag, small glass whiteboard, HDMI TV, dimmable lighting, and sensory/self-care collection items.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed by the library as a reservable sensory-friendly room on the second floor.

cards.title: Library 214B Sensory-Friendly Room
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use this two-seat option for a quieter working setup: it has a long table, beanbag, small glass whiteboard, dimmable lighting, and self-care items.
cards.short_summary: A two-seat sensory-friendly room for a quieter setup.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 214B has one long table with two chairs, a beanbag, small glass whiteboard, dimmable lighting, and sensory/self-care collection items.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed by the library as a reservable sensory-friendly room on the second floor.

cards.title: Library 218–222 Solo Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Pick one of these five back-of-floor rooms for individual work; each room provides a table and a single chair for a simple solo setup.
cards.short_summary: Five dedicated one-person rooms along the back of the second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 218–222 are five rooms along the back of the second floor, each with a table and one chair, and are described as ideal for solo work.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed as reservable conference and study rooms on the second floor.

cards.title: Library 230 Lois’ Study
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve Lois’ Study for a larger work session: its conference-table seating for 12, large glass whiteboard, and HDMI TV are set up for team review.
cards.short_summary: A 12-seat conference-style study room with a large whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Library 230, Lois’ Study, has conference-table seating for 12, a large glass whiteboard, and a TV with HDMI hookup for personal computers.
cards.source_title: Library Room Reservations | Courtright Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Listed by the library as a reservable conference and study room on the second floor.
